documented_probe: C-ac4a9918 (declare the mailing-list configuration in the canonical file): the second covering task; the verifier fully checks the capability — the canonical config path, its documented semantics, and the live daemon honoring it after an idempotent provision script runs on visible and hidden specs.
notes: Medium: write an idempotent provisioner that renders a spec CSV into the canonical /etc/loopd/lists.conf (documented INI-like semantics: last-section-wins, enabled only on exact 'true', members in config order), signal the already-running daemon (SIGHUP via pidfile, no restart), and emit a live-state report. Hidden cases re-execute the provisioner on other specs (reordered lists, tagged member addresses, disabled lists, an empty spec), so hard-coded lists fail. Rubric nonzero for dependent stages (config -> reload -> verify), tool breadth (signals/sockets), reasoning depth, debugging ambiguity (canonical path + reload semantics), adversarial inputs (empty spec, disabled lists, verbatim tagged addresses), hidden-case generalization, and interaction statefulness (live daemon).
